slots.name: number of ships redirected
slots.sentence: A total of 75 ships heading into or exiting Iranian ports redirected by U.S. military blockade on the Strait of Hormuz, according to U.S. Central Command .

slots.name: volume of crude oil moved out of Persian Gulf
slots.sentence: He said while the U.S. had enabled those ships to move 750 million barrels of crude oil out of the Persian Gulf, "Iran has exported zero barrels of oil from its shores since we resumed the naval blockade in mid-July."

slots.name: status of Iranian oil exports
slots.sentence: Iranian Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad acknowledged on Thursday that the country's exports had "declined to some extent" — which is likely a significant understatement — but he insisted "the sale of our oil outside our territorial waters, in distant waters — meaning the delivery of oil to our customers — has continued," despite the U.S. blockade.

number of vessels evacuated

slots.name: mariners killed
slots.sentence: At least 19 mariners have been killed in the region since Feb. 28, when the U.S. and Israel jointly launched the war on Iran.

slots.name: number of vessels assisted in transiting
